text:
Riley (People Ops): quick thread for managers: hiring freeze is lifting next month and were seeing promo + backfill combos. putting answers here so ppl don't DM.
Pri (Eng Manager): timeline Q: if freeze lifts 2026-01-15 and i have an approved promo effective 2026-01-01, does payroll need extra steps?
Jordan (Payroll): effective date 01-01 is fine but payroll needs final comp-change in system by 2025-12-22 to hit Jan payroll. if approvals cross the freeze-lift, we can still process but expect manual review.
Pri (Eng Manager): ok. next: we want to offer a short-term retention bump for an IC with critical customer commitments while backfill is open. process?
Sam (Comp): retention bumps <10% can be handled as temporary spot bonuses (one-off) approved by manager + comp partner. >10% need director + comp committee + finance sign-off. document customer impact and timeline.
Nina (Hiring Ops): note for backfill: tag req with `freeze-lift-priority` and include the promo ticket ID. hiring ops will fast-track screening once headcount is cleared after 01-15.
Pri (Eng Manager): if we promise a retention bump and then hire a replacement faster than expected, do we convert the bump into base comp?
Sam (Comp): we avoid converting temporary bumps to base without comp committee approval. if manager wants base change, submit market/adjustment workflow. include retention context.
Riley (People Ops): what about confidential retention packages for senior ICs who might leak offers? any limits?
Sam (Comp): we recommend structured retention (bonus + clear end date) rather than unilateral permanent raises. Talent must sign off on confidentiality clauses if included. loop Legal for high-risk cases.
Pri (Eng Manager): evidence/packet Q: if a promotion and a backfill req are opened together, do i attach the same evidence to both tickets?
Nina (Hiring Ops): attach the promo evidence to the promo ticket and a 1-line justification + link to promo packet on the backfill req. keeps audit trails clean.
Riley (People Ops): edge case: manager wants to fast-track a promo due to customer SLA breach impact. how fast is fast-track?
Sam (Comp): we can run a 72-hr fast-track if manager + director + comp partner + finance sign-off. include explicit customer risk and proposed mitigation. decisions are recorded and final.
Pri (Eng Manager): international nuance: someone in APAC wants promo effective Jan but local payroll closes earlier. any pointer?
Jordan (Payroll): APAC payroll calendars vary. confirm with payroll by 2025-12-15 for Jan effective dates. some countries limit retro beyond 30 days. Legal may need to review.
Riley (People Ops): appeals: if an employee disputes a retention decision or promo outcome during freeze-lift, do we treat it differently?
Sam (Comp): appeals follow normal process: 14-day window post-manager notify. during freeze-lift we track appeals for the comp committee separately to ensure consistency.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled: "Freeze lift & promo backlog review" on 2026-01-10 09:00 PT.
Pri (Eng Manager): thanks everyone. i'll collate manager FAQs and add a short template for retention justification.
Riley (People Ops): i'll post the retention template and the fast-track form to #people-ops-resources and tag @Sam for pre-review. thx all :white_check_mark:
